top_signals.title: Policy paper: India-UK 4th Financial Markets Dialogue: Joint Statement
top_signals.summary: This document is a joint statement between HM Treasury and the Indian Ministry of Finance, and is a public record of what was covered at the fourth Financial Markets Dialogue held on Tuesday 29 September 2026.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Can Gene-Edited Mosquitoes Beat Malaria?
top_signals.summary: Gene-edited mosquitoes could help prevent malaria transmission without eliminating the insects, but significant risks remain. Small, controlled releases could help test the approach while monitoring its effects, writes the Editorial Board. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.summary: Microsoft has released the Patch Tuesday Windows 11 KB5127648 and KB5126653 cumulative updates for versions 26H2/25H2/24H2 and 23H2 to fix security vulnerabilities and bugs, and add new features. [...]
